name: Heat Metal
description: Choose a manufactured metal object within range. Any creature in physical contact with it takes 2d8 fire damage when you cast the spell; until the spell ends you can use a bonus action on each of your later turns to deal this damage again. Dropping the object and the disadvantage while holding it are not modelled. At Higher Levels: +1d8 per slot level above 2nd.

m.text: a piece of iron and a flame
